listings.description: About Morpho Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world. Why Morpho Exists Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here . Location Paris or remote (from -5h GMT up to +2h GMT to ensure sufficient overlap with the rest of the team). listings.description: About us We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. listings.title: Senior / Lead Program Manager
listings.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

About the role

Nebius is looking for a Senior / Lead Program Manager to help develop and execute our asset-light model for expanding AI infrastructure through partnerships.

You will work at the intersection of strategy, finance, commercial negotiations and execution. Your focus will be to turn complex partnership opportunities into clear business cases, workable commercial terms and agreements that support the needs of Nebius, our partners and our customers.

This role suits someone who combines structured problem-solving with strong financial understanding and the ability to move work forward across multiple teams. You should be comfortable assessing commercial trade-offs, bringing clarity to ambiguous problems and taking responsibility for progress.

This is an individual contributor role with significant cross-functional responsibility. You will lead projects and influence stakeholders without direct line-management responsibility.

What you’ll do

  • Develop commercial frameworks and term sheets. Define proposed terms for asset-light part

listings.title: Solutions Engineer
listings.description: About the Role Join the pre-sales team at a Series A industrial R&D software company, serving as a technical partner to prospective customers. You will connect deep chemistry and materials science expertise with value-based selling to help R&D organizations modernize data management and accelerate product development. What You'll Do Own the technical pre-sales process from initial demonstrations through value cases, technical evaluations, and pilot execution. Build tailored demonstrations, workshops, and pilots around prospective customers' R&D workflows. Partner with account executives and customer champions to communicate business value and support new business growth. Lead technical evaluations and present how modern R&D data platforms can improve data management and innovation. Mentor early-career team members supporting technical evaluations. Write Python scripts and configure integrations as needed for customer engagements. Travel 25% to 50% for prospect meetings, presentations, and workshops. What We're Looking For Four to seven years of relevant experience, including at least four years in digitalization, change management, or R&D leadership. An MS or PhD in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, or a related field, ideally with a computational or machine learning focus. Strong chemistry or materials science expertise and familiarity with enterprise R&D workflows and laboratory informatics systems. Experience building and demonstrating technical platforms for enterprise customers, with a value-based selling approach. Background in digitalization or change management, preferably in industrial R&D; technical consulting experience is also relevant. Python scripting skills and willingness to travel regularly. Fluent English and advanced proficiency in the relevant local language for European-based candidates. Authorization to work in the United States, United Kingdom, or Germany. Visa sponsorship is not available. Compensation & Benefits Base salary

listings.title: Senior Partner, Germany
listings.description: About the Role A legal technology company is seeking a Senior Partner to help grow an AI-enabled law practice in Germany. You will bring an established client practice, continue advising clients, and help move recurring legal work onto AI-powered workflows. What You'll Do Help shape the firm's growth and contribute to its path toward Series A. Transition your portable client practice to the firm's platform while continuing to serve those clients. Build market credibility and develop opportunities through your private equity, venture capital, and mid-market network. Identify cross-selling opportunities for commercial and compliance services across your client base. Work with the founding team to automate recurring legal matters using AI agents. What We're Looking For 12 to 20 or more years of German legal practice, with experience at partner level. German-qualified Volljurist admitted as a Rechtsanwalt, with native-level German and professional English. A personally portable book of business valued at €1 million or more, with a diversified client base that follows you independently of a large-firm brand. Strong relationships with private equity or venture capital firms and their portfolio companies, or a comparable mid-market client network. Experience with recurring, automatable work such as commercial contracts, IT and data, corporate and venture capital, or regulatory matters. Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or legal AI products, and a willingness to adapt legal workflows to automation. A feasible client transition plan, including a notice period and no restrictions that prevent moving your practice. Compensation & Benefits Base salary range: €200,000 to €300,000 annually. Meaningful equity is offered. Visa sponsorship is not available. Location Berlin, Germany. The role may be based in person or remote within Germany; Berlin in-person work is preferred. listings.title: Werkstudent*in Promotion (m/w/d)
listings.description: Wir suchen Student*innen mit ENERGY für Berlin Bei Octopus treiben wir die Energiewende voran: fair, einfach und mit Fokus auf erneuerbare Energien. Du das Eis brichst: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und sorgst für Aufmerksamkeit rund um unseren Stand. Du verbindest: Wenn jemand neugierig ist, übergibst du das Gespräch ganz entspannt an unsere Expert*innen am Stand. Teamwork: Gemeinsam mit dem Team vor Ort machst du den Tag erfolgreich und hast Spaß dabei! Das bringst du mit: Eingeschriebene*r Student*in an einer Berliner Hochschule oder Universität - idealerweise mit Ausblick auf eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit (mind. 1 Jahr Reststudienzeit). Kommunikationsfreude: Du sprichst gern mit Menschen, bist offen und bringst eine positive Ausstrahlung mit. Sprachen: Du bringst gute Deutschkenntnisse mit (Niveau C1). Du sprichst zusätzlich noch eine andere Sprache? Perfekt für Berlin - wir freuen uns über jede Mehrsprachigkeit! Vorerfahrung brauchst du keine - deine Ausstrahlung und Motivation zählen! Dein Studi-Job wartet – zeig uns, wer du bist! Bock auf deinen flexiblen Studi-Job? Bewirb dich in nur 2 Minuten – ganz ohne langes Anschreiben! listings.description: Talent Acquisition Intern Deine Mission bei trawa Bei trawa sind wir überzeugt: Die Energiewende beginnt bei den Menschen, die sie möglich machen. listings.description: About us People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry. Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality. Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies. How we work Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents. Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate. At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work. End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it. In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication. Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly. Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues. You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built. listings.title: Assistant Financial Controller
listings.description: About Flock Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! About the role Reporting to Sarah Phillips, you’ll own month-end for Flock’s finance team and strengthen the controls around it, running the close and producing the variance analysis and MI that FP&A and our senior team use for budgeting and reporting. We’re automating finance on our new platform and the team uses AI every day, so there’s plenty of room to improve how the work gets done as well as doing it. It suits a recently qualified accountant with strong core accounting from practice, who has already improved a process or control somewhere and wants to keep growing within the finance team. What you’ll be doing Own the month-end close from start to finish so it lands accurately and on time. Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and post journals, keeping the ledger clean and well evidenced. Run variance analysis and build the monthly MI pack, explaining what moved and why. Strengthen our financial controls and automate manual steps wherever you find them. Prepare our VAT returns and assist with group reporting. Work with FP&A so the numbers behind budgets and senior reporting are right. Support the annual audit and work alongside our external audit

Data Scientist | Semiconductor Metrology
Abingdon, UK

Reward and Benefits

  • £42,000 - £55,000 (depending on experience)

If you are a Data Scientist who enjoys turning instrument data into proof of what is possible, why not join us in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, and help prove the analysis methods behind advanced semiconductor metrology systems.

Als netwerk-expert binnen onze afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor onderzoek en ontwikkeling gericht op netwerken en systemen die verschillende simulatoren en operationele systemen veilig en efficiënt met elkaar verbinden. Je levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan het mogelijk maken van interoperabiliteit tussen simulatoren, operationele systemen en autonome platforms, en bent betrokken bij de (door)ontwikkeling van zowel bestaande als nieuwe simulatienetwerken. Je bent hiervoor bereid om te reizen naar verschillende locaties, voornamelijk binnen Nederland. Wat breng je mee? Je bent iemand die in kansen denkt en nieuwsgierig is om bij te dragen aan oplossingen die werken in de praktijk. Je hebt heel makkelijk contact met eindgebruikers en kan hun wensen en ideeën snel in creatieve implementaties omzetten. Met je creatieve instelling maak je nieuwe technieken snel eigen en weet je deze te vertalen naar concrete resultaten! listings.title: Mid-Market Account Executive - Nordics
listings.description:
Mid-Market Account Executive

As an Account Executive on our Mid-Market Sales team, you will assist in Datadog’s overall business growth by strategically engaging and closing net-new customers across mid-to-large size organizations. Sellers follow a well-defined methodology, collaborate with internal stakeholders, identify the customer's unique needs, and clearly convey the value of the Datadog product. Mid-Market reps have the opportunity to grow their careers in Sales and continue contributing to Datadog team success.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Focus entirely on net-new logo acquisition
  • Convert inbound leads to closed opportunities 
  • Leverage tools such as Sales Navigator and DiscoverOrg
  • Strategically prospect into Chief Technology Officers, Engineering/IT Leaders, and technical end users (SRE, DevOps, DevSecOps)
  • Multi-thread into different departments of a complex organization
  • Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives to drive top of funnel activity
  • Manage the full sales cycle, including negotiations and on-site technical demonstrations 

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

Who You Are:

  • Experienced in hunting and closing net new logos
  • Able to strategically map out and break into large scale organizations
  • Curious, motivated, and driven as a sales person
  • Bold on the phones and creative in your emails
